data.name: Hilwana
data.gender_notes: Hilwana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-l-w', which signifies 'gracefulness', 'beauty', and 'elegance'. Hilwana is a name that signifies the embodiment of these qualities. The name Hilwana carries the meaning “Graceful, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hilwana usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the beauty and grace of Allah's creation.
data.etymology: Hilwana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hilwana total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: هلوينة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الجمال والرقة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم هلوينة هو اسم عربي مؤنث، مشتق من الفعل 'هلا' الذي يعني الإجابة أو القبول، وينتهي بـ 'ينة' التي تشير إلى الصفة أو الحالة. يوحي الاسم بالجمال والرقة، وقد ورد في بعض المصادر العربية القديمة كوصف للطبيعة أو للشخصيات الجميلة. كما أن الاسم يحمل دلالة على الإشراق والوضوح، مما يجعله من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ہلوینہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت اور پیارا نام اردو زبان میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہلوینہ ایک عربی मूल کا اسم ہے جو اردو زبان میں بھی مستعمل ہے۔ اس کا تعلق فعل 'ہلا' سے ہے جس کا مطلب ہے جواب دینا یا قبول کرنا، اور اس کے آخر میں 'ینہ' لاحقہ ہے جو صفت یا حالت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام خوبصورتی اور ملائمت کی دلالت کرتا ہے، اور بعض پرانے اردو مصادر میں اس کا ذکر قدرتی مناظر یا خوبصورت شخصیات کے وصف کے طور پر کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हलविना
in_hindi.meaning: देवनागरी लिपि में हलविना नाम का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: हलविना नाम एक सुंदर और प्यारा नाम है जो देवनागरी लिपि में लिखा जाता है। इसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है और यह नाम सुंदरता और कोमलता की विशेषता को दर्शाता है। हलविना नाम की जड़ें अरबी शब्द 'हला' में हैं, जिसका अर्थ है उत्तर देना या स्वीकार करना, और इसके अंत में 'विना' प्रत्यय है जो एक विशेषता या स्थिति को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: هلوینه
in_pashto.meaning: په پښتو کې د هلوینه نوم معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: هلوینه نوم د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چی د ښکلا او نرمي معنی لري. دغه نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د 'هلا' فعل څخه مشتق شوی دی، چی معنی یې د ځواب وی یا منل، او په پای کې یې 'ینه' لیکل شوی دی چی د ځانګړتیا یا حالت ښودلو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Hilwana
in_english.meaning: A beautiful and lovely name in Islamic tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hilwana is of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'h-l-w' which conveys meanings of beauty, loveliness, and acceptance. In Arabic, the name is associated with the verb 'hila' meaning to answer or accept. The suffix '-wana' adds a connotation of being in a state of beauty or loveliness. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to describe natural scenery or to signify beauty and elegance. In Islamic tradition, names are chosen for their meanings and spiritual significance, and Hilwana embodies these qualities.

data.cultural_impact: In many Islamic cultures, a beautiful name is highly valued. By giving a child the name Hilwana, parents signify their hope that their child will be graceful, elegant, and beautiful, both inside and out. It is an aspiration for their child to be held in high esteem by their community, as a person who radiates beauty and charm.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, beauty and grace are viewed as important aspects of the Divine. The Quran describes God as having great beauty and the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) encouraged his followers to adorn themselves and their homes with beauty, as part of the remembrance of God. Hilwana is a reminder of these qualities and a constant reminder for the bearer of the name to strive towards embodiment of these spiritual values. It is a reminder of the beauty of God's creation and a reminder to live in a beautiful and graceful manner.
